Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

The Canonical Public Cloud team is looking for enthusiastic engineers to be Ubuntu distribution engineers. Engineers working on the Ubuntu distribution will work closely with the Ubuntu Engineering organization to ensure technologies such as cloud specific agents, webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks are optimized for public clouds. CPC works closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, IBM, and Oracle and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensuring a common operating experience for their users. Working on the CPC team as a distro engineer means working closely with partners and with Ubuntu to make the best version of Ubuntu for the cloud.

Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. The Public Cloud team builds Ubuntu Server for cloud environments, maintaining extensive continuous deployment operations to deliver images to end users. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.

This role entails

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users
  • Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers

Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events

  • Interest in containerization and virtualization such as Docker or OCI service containers, LXD system containers, and local virtualization like Virtualbox or QEMU, or Public Clouds

title: Staff engineer - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
description:
Staff engineer - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)

Direct message the job poster from Doctoralia Brasil

Innovation Lead at DocPlanner | Making life easier with AI | Neurodiverse

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote-friendly.

Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Hybrid model (CWB) : If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer to co-lead our modernization efforts, drive innovation, and play a key role in our product evolution. Your expertise in cloud technologies, legacy system migrations, and microservices will help modernize our architecture and enhance scalability, ensuring the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

Role

As a Staff Engineer in this area, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for leading impactful and complex cross-group and cross-area technical initiatives, ensuring high-quality solutions with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with Engineering Managers and other tech counterparts to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to actively contribute to the technical direction of the area.

Our tech stack at Docplanner Tech includes .Net, PHP, and Vue/React, running on Kubernetes in AWS. While expertise in these technologies isn’t required, this is a very technical and hands-on role, for which strong communication skills and experience influencing technical decisions are also essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

  • Lead and drive technical initiatives that impact area level directions (~5 teams).
  • Actively partner with your Engineering Manager / Tech lead counterparts and engineering teams, as well as working closely with the leaders of the area/company to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Provide accountability for all the technical initiatives led.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Engineering teams.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team.

Qualifications

You’re likely a great fit for this role if you:

  • Have a solid technical background related to the whole SDLC principles and practices (Agile/CD, Lean, SRE, DevOps) and can support and unblock engineering teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Legacy software modernization and migration: proven experience in modernizing and migrating legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long-term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high-quality solutions.
  • Have a strong experience in backend development with a holistic understanding of full-stack systems.
  • Experience in cross-team initiative and creating buy-in for technical initiatives.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Have experience not only designing/implementing/delivering high-quality and impactful solutions, but also guiding and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Also Relevant For The Role

  • Domain Driven Design.
  • Expertise in AWS to help shaping our cloud infrastructure.
  • Ability to oversee database optimizations (MySQL) for scalable solutions.
  • Cloud-native architectures using microservices and serverless along with interaction styles, as synchronous and asynchronous communication, data streaming, and API technologies and lifecycle management.
  • Advanced English skills: comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

Additional Information

Doctoralia’s Benefits

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options - eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period) -
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Other information

Workplace Location:

  • Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).
  • Hybrid model (CWB): If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).
  • Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.
  • We provide feedback at all stages

Até então, já entregamos mais de 800 projetos, consolidando um portfólio robusto com clientes de grande porte, como Petrobras, BRASKEM, Modec, PRIO, Nestlé e Gerdau.

title: Electrical Engineer - Power Generation
description:
Join to apply for the Electrical Engineer - Power Generation role at Prismecs

Join to apply for the Electrical Engineer - Power Generation role at Prismecs

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Prismecs is at the forefront of transforming energy solutions on a global scale. As trailblazers in supply chain and engineering, we empower industrial teams to break through barriers in sectors like power generation and oil & gas. With a strategic presence in key markets around the globe. We're not just a company; we're a dynamic global force.

Prismecs merges domain expertise with cutting-edge innovation, especially in sectors such as power generation, oil & gas, metals, mining, and data centers. We specialize in tailoring solutions for maximum uptime, offering an unparalleled platform for your skills to thrive. If you're driven to make a tangible impact in the industrial realm, envision yourself contributing to a team at Prismecs that prioritizes reliability and integrity at every stage.

We are seeking for a qualified and experienced Electrical Engineer to support the operations and maintenance of our gas-to-power facility featuring aero-derivative or industrial gas turbines. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial electrical systems and power generation equipment, with a focus on safety, reliability, and preventative maintenance for plants operating on natural gas or liquid fuel

Start Date: Immediately

Location: On-site at a customer facility

Responsibilities

  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot electrical systems, including turbine auxiliaries, generators, switchgear, MCCs, lighting, and plant-wide distribution systems.
  • Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on electrical equipment.
  • Support commissioning activities including first fire, FSNL, and synchronization events.
  • Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards, lock-out/tag-out (LOTO), and company HSE policies.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Assist with the installation and commissioning of new equipment and electrical upgrades.
  • Respond to equipment failures and support after-hours emergency troubleshooting if required.
  • Work closely with controls engineers and mechanical teams to support overall plant operations.

Qualifications

  • A degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, licensed electrician, or equivalent certification (national or regional).
  • 3+ years of experience in industrial or power generation electrical systems.
  • Experience with electrical systems in power plants utilizing aero-derivative or industrial turbine generators operating on natural gas or liquid fuel.
  • Proficient with low- and medium-voltage systems and protective relays.
  • Knowledge of control panels, VFDs, UPS systems, and grounding systems.
  • Ability to safely operate test equipment (megger, multimeter, clamp meter, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of electrical codes and safety regulations (e.g., NEC, IEC, OSHA/NFPA 70E).
  • Willingness to work in a rotation schedule or extended hours as needed during outages or critical operations.
  • Proficient in English; additional languages are an asset.

Applicants must submit CV/ Resume in English

At Prismecs, we value expertise, accountability, and innovation. You'll be part of a diverse team where your experience matters, and your work makes a direct impact on industrial success and energy sustainability. Join us in shaping the future of global energy!Seniority level

title: Senior Network & Information Security Engineer - Brazil
description:
Your impact

You will have the opportunity to be a leader of a team responsible for the design and implementation of Intelsat’s growing datacenter presence around the world. As a Sr. Network Engineer at Intelsat, you will lead projects as well as assist on many team projects that will challenge your skills with routing, switching, data security, VoIP, and multi-media services. This position will work with and manage many vendor relationships, as well as having a voice during the purchase/quote process, as Intelsat’s business continues to expand. You will provide Network and Information Security support and analysis, including Network device lifecycle, incident analysis and response, log analysis, threat and vulnerability management, and network and security architecture and design.

What you will do

  • Lead network troubleshooting sessions
  • Manage network device lifecycle tasks (OS upgrades, vulnerability patching, etc…)
  • Coordinate change management outage activities with multiple groups/departments
  • Resolve complex routing issues
  • Collaborate with your team members and cross-departmental teams
  • Identify opportunities to improve our Information Security posture

Your required experience/skills

  • 4-year college degree
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience with routing and switching technologies
  • Military experience along with 5-7 years’ experience in related job field will be considered in lieu of college degree

Your success in this role will look like:

  • A collaborative team member tasked with implementing new and exciting technologies that drive our business efficiencies and support our employees and customer revenue stream.
  • Provide network and security operational support to an Enterprise community with a presence around the world, and manage the associated infrastructure relating to network, and security tools.
  • Be a creative thinking team player, with openness, embracing diverse thinking and styles, with a positive attitude.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Resumes should be written in English

It would be nice if you had:

  • Experience with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, RIPv2, MPLS, PBR, HSRP, VRRP, GLBP)
  • Experience with dual homing service providers and ISP redundancy
  • Experience working with Cisco hardware including switches, routers, ASRs, ASA, FWSM, IPS, load balancers, Nexus
  • Experience with F5 load balancing and geographical load balancing is a plus
  • Experience with security protocols, TACACS, RADIUS, different flavors of VPN and remote access.
  • Experience with Telco services, T1, DS3, SONET, OC3 – 192

How we support you:

  • Hybrid work environment offering up to two days per week work from home (for eligible positions)
  • Development opportunities supporting professional growth championed by our dedicated Learning & Development team. 20-25% of our positions are hired internally!
  • Ways to get involved: satellite launch parties, company connect events, charitable activities, team social events, recognition programs, and employee resource groups.
  • Wide range of benefits and perks to help you stay healthy, happy, and productive. These include paid leave programs, medical, tuition reimbursement, and retirement benefits, employee wellness offerings, and more!

Our D&I Commitment

We’re committed to fostering a culture and environment of diversity, inclusion and respect – a place where everyone can show up fully as themselves and do their best work every day. We're a technology leader committed to advancing diverse, inclusive teams – where belonging is rooted in our culture. Intelsat has an established Diversity & Inclusion Council and Employee Resource Groups.   • Provide Network and Security Engineering services to enhance and grow Intelsat's data network.
  • Provide input to the IT Engineering roadmap pertaining to Network and Information Security that clearly identifies gaps and mitigation techniques to close the gaps.
  • Contribute to the technical understanding and promotion of new and existing Network and Information Security standards and solutions.
  • Assist in conducting periodic internal and external Network and Information Security audits and assessments.

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
The Cost Optimization team is responsible for identifying cost reduction opportunities within Brazil Operations without compromising safety or service quality.

Brazil Operations is a critical business unit for SBM Offshore’s cash flow, handling 20-30% of Brazil’s oil production.

The cost structure of Brazil Operations is heavily focused on maintenance activities that ensure FPSOs (Floating Production Storage and Offloading units) can operate for up to 25 years in remote ocean locations, ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of hulls and tanks.

The Senior Cost Controller will be a key player in this strategic initiative, requiring a blend of strategic vision and strong skills in modeling and data analysis.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  1. Understand the cost structure of Brazil Operations to identify areas of high expenditure within the P&L.
  2. Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities by assessing financial feasibility (business cases), developing projections/forecasts, and maximizing returns.
  3. Lead or collaborate on cost-reduction projects with internal teams (e.g., Supply Chain, HR, Maintenance), providing critical analysis of both cost and performance data that impacts costs (e.g., productivity). This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), data gathering, insights generation, proposing improvements, and influencing business transformation.
  4. Improve cost tracking processes by generating regular optimization reports using internal systems (e.g., ERP). Take responsibility for data from source to transformation, including dashboard creation and data flow automation. Ensure data consistency, quality, and governance, collaborating with IT.
  5. Support communication initiatives to raise awareness among employees about the importance of cost management, linking it to the company’s long-term strategy.
REQUIREMENTS
  1. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.
  2. An MBA or a master’s degree in finance is highly desirable.
  3. Solid experience in consulting, cost optimization, cost analysis, financial efficiency, corporate finance, financial modeling, project valuation, strategic planning, data intelligence, data analytics, business intelligence, or process optimization.
  4. Fluent in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  5. Experience with databases modeling tools (e.g., Access, Alteryx, Power Pivot/Power Query, ETL, Star Schema, OLAP, master data management, cubes, or similar), managing large datasets.
  6. Basic knowledge in the following (no professional experience required): SQL or any programming language.
  7. Project valuation and business cases (e.g., ROI, NPV).
  8. Key financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  9. Basic knowledge of the Oil and Gas industry is desirable.
  10. Familiarity with Maintenance Strategy and Integrity concepts is a plus.

Transformação através da inovação e empreendedorismo!

“Somos a Arca Hub, o primeiro hub de inovação do Rio de Janeiro, criado para fomentar conexões entre startups, grandes empresas, agentes do setor público e academia. Ser uma pessoa organizada;

Comunicativa;

Extrovertida;

Domínio do pacote Office;

Falar inglês.

;

Ter participado de alguma entidade estudantil como: Empresa Júnior, Atlética, Enactus, iniciação científica, etc..

Conhecimento na ferramenta de Lives do Youtube(Stream Yard).

Aqui você encontra:

Flexibilidade de horário;

Ambiente colaborativo e super amigável, criativo e crescimento acelerado;

Um ecossistema inovador e cheio de possibilidades, onde você terá contato com startups, grandes empresas e agentes do setor público e academia circulando diariamente pelo Hub.

description:

Para verificar as etapas pendentes siga os passos abaixo:
1. Acesse o site e realize seu login
2. Clique em “Meus processos”.
3. Selecione a vaga para a qual você se candidatou.
4. Visualize as etapas obrigatórias e clique em “Faça agora” ao encontrar a etapa pendente.

Esse é o seu momento de contribuir com projetos que promovem o desenvolvimento tecnológico e social do Brasil. Inscreva-se e faça parte dessa missão!

Horário : 14h às 18h

Local: Praia do Flamengo, 200 – Flamengo. CEP: 22210-060

Setor: CGDA

Atividades :

Identificação, classificação e ordenação de documentos conforme planos de classificação. Separação de documentos por tipo, data, assunto ou setor de origem. Apoio na aplicação de instrumentos de gestão documental, como tabela de temporalidade. Digitalização de documentos físicos para sistemas eletrônicos. Verificação da qualidade das imagens digitalizadas. Apoio na preservação de documentos físicos (limpeza, acondicionamento, reparos simples). Alimentação de bases de dados e sistemas informatizados de arquivos (SIGA-FINEP) Auxílio na busca de documentos solicitados por usuários internos ou externos. Atendimento a consultas presenciais ou virtuais sobre o acervo. Apoio em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à CGDA. Elaboração de relatórios e registros de atividades de estágio. Participação em reuniões da equipe de arquivo e capacitações. REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Estar matriculado no curso de Arquivologia, a partir do 2º período até 6º período.

Ter conhecimento em Informática: Domínio do pacote Office (word, excel)

Bom relacionamento interpessoal, proatividade, responsabilidade e pontualidade.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Sobre a Peça Rara:

Quer trabalhar na rede de brechós mais sustentável do Brasil?

Com 17 anos de atuação no mercado e mais de 100 lojas espalhadas pelo Brasil, a rede de Brechós Peça Rara com já nasceu com o propósito da reutilização de roupas como forma de promover a sustentabilidade e é prova do sucesso da chamada economia circular.

Com a mudança nos hábitos de consumo, a procura pela moda sustentável subiu exponencialmente nos últimos anos e a tendência é só aumentar. A rede espera dobrar os pontos de vendas até o fim de 2024 para atender a demanda.

Se você deseja promover mudanças significativas e tangíveis no mundo e se considera um profissional que se realiza em um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, esse é o lugar certo para você!

Etiquetar e alarmar as peças que foram cadastradas; Organizar e manter organizado o local de trabalho; Levar mercadorias para o salão de vendas; Separar produtos para devolução. title: Analista de Eventos
description:
Descrição

Você é aquela pessoa que mantém a calma nas situações mais críticas, acolhe com empatia e age com agilidade quando o outro mais precisa? Então vem com a gente!Estamos em busca de um(a) Atendente de Eventos que saiba acolher com agilidade e segurança os nossos associados nos momentos mais delicados como roubos, furtos e colisões.
Sua missão será transformar situações críticas em experiências de confiança , acompanhando cada etapa com transparência, alinhando processos com prestadores e garantindo que tudo esteja dentro das normas da associação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Recebimento e Registro do Evento:

Atender o associado com empatia e agilidade no primeiro contato seja por telefone, e-mail ou presencialmente registrando o aviso de sinistro de forma clara, acolhedora e eficiente. Esse é o ponto de partida para uma experiência positiva, mesmo em momentos delicados.

Análise de Cobertura e Documentação:

Avaliar com precisão se o evento está dentro das condições da proteção veicular, analisando atentamente os documentos e informações fornecidas. Atuamos com total transparência e foco na agilidade, garantindo que o associado receba uma resposta segura e objetiva.

Processo de Compensação:

Gerenciar cada etapa da compensação com atenção aos detalhes, assegurando que os valores devidos sejam calculados e disponibilizados conforme as regras da proteção. Todo o processo é conduzido com foco na satisfação do associado e no cumprimento rigoroso das normas da associação. 

Atendimento Humanizado e Resolutivo:

Oferecer um atendimento eficiente, transparente e orientado à solução, minimizando o impacto do ocorrido e garantindo que o associado se sinta seguro e bem acolhido em todas as etapas do processo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino médio – Completo
Conhecimento de Pacote Office.

title: Engagement Leader
description:
• This role can be based in Sao Paulo OR Rio de Janeiro
  • Please submit a resume in English


Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as a Consultant, you will continue to learn and deepen your consulting skills by working on various projects. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.


Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.


You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.


The Ideal Candidate:


Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.


Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Management Trainee Program
description:
About the job

Come Join our Family Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!


What you'll be doing:


This 18-month Global Management Trainee Program at Plaza Premium Group is designed to develop the next generation of supervisory leaders in the global traveler hospitality industry with a specialized development track: Operational Management Trainee . Trainees gain hands-on experience by rotating through diﬀerent departments, across diﬀerent cities or countries, from behind-the-scenes roles to customer-facing positions in operations, guest services, and more.


This 360-degree view of the business gives trainees a deep understanding of how the company works under the inﬂuence of PPG's culture. In addition to the on-the-job training, trainees also contribute to the company's global projects. This helps them build critical skills such as project management, budgeting, and collaborating across teams. The goal is to equip them with the leadership abilities and global mindset needed to take on supervisory responsibilities within Plaza Premium Group's worldwide network of over 5,800 employees in 30+ countries.

Participate in training sessions and workshops to develop a strong foundation in the traveler hospitality industry and the Plaza Premium Group's operations.

  • Participate Global Projects: You are invited to participate our new exciting global projects at various locations. To learn how business ideas come to live with project management, budgeting concepts and collaboration with cross-functional teams to unlock challenges and deliver results.
  • Personal Development Training: Continue to develop yourself around your professional-self, ranging from various forms of self-development training workshops, management skills workshops, soft-skills development, project-based task force assignment and mentorship with experienced leaders within the organization.

  • Proﬁciency in Portuguese and English and an additional language will be a plus.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage


(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility


What We’re Looking For:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture



Who is Xelvin?


Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.


Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!


As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.


What do we offer?


Contract wise:


· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)



Onboarding & benefits:


· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.


· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.


· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.


· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.


· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.


· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;


o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.


o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”)..
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Júnior | Riscos e Compliance
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

A área de Inteligência de Negócios tem como missão monitorar riscos e garantir a conformidade da operação dos stakeholders da companhia através de soluções automatizadas e análise de dados.


Nosso Jeito:​

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.​


Valores e Propósito:​

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos​.


Diversidade e Inclusão:​

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.​


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Manusear grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a integridade e qualidade dos dados. Com orientação para resolver problemas complexos de inconsistência de dados;
  • Realizar análises de dados para identificar padrões básicos e anomalias, utilizando ferramentas e técnicas predefinidas. Focar em tarefas como análises descritivas e diagnóstico de dados com supervisão;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios, com foco na clareza e precisão das informações. Responsável pela geração de relatórios periódicos e dashboards padrão utilizando a plataforma Looker Studio;
  • Fornecer suporte analítico básico para a tomada de decisões, focando na clareza e apresentação de dados relevantes. Participar de reuniões de equipe como ouvinte e contribuidor;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de modelos preditivos simples sob orientação de analistas mais experientes. Envolver-se na coleta de dados, preparação de datasets e testes para modelagem;
  • Apoiar a investigação de incidentes e anomalias identificados, realizando análises preliminares e compilando dados para revisões mais detalhadas;


Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards;
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas de DataViz;
  • Compreensão dos conceitos básicos de estatística e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento básico de programação e ferramentas de ETL.


Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento básico do bigquery;
  • Conhecimento básico Looker Studio;
  • Conhecimento básico Apache Airflow/Google Cloud Composer;
  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados/engenharia de dados.


OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

title: Scrum Master de Dados Especialista | Gerencia Dados BU
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

O Scrum Master vai atuar apoiando o PO no planejamento das demandas e projetos de dados (desenvolvimento interno ou externo), no modelo Scrum, fazendo toda a ponte com time técnico de desenvolvimento. Fará planejamento estorias, apoiará o time técnico de dados na definição de soluções, acompanhará cronogramas no jira, e ajudará no tratamento dos impedimentos de desenvolvimento, correções advindas dos roteiros de testes, GMUD, rollout produção, transição de conhecimento para time de sustentação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Fazer o planejamento do cronograma desenvolvimento de todos os projetos da area (modelo Scrum). Deve saber mexer no jira (cadastrar estórias, tarefas, metricas de esforço por pontos, garantir a atualização dos dados no jira, status report, conduzir agendas de daily e agendas técnicas), para garantirmos a execução dos entregas planejadas nas sprints
  • Atuar junto com o PO para garantir que os requisitos do produto estão aderentes e sendo atendidos nas sprints
  • Garantir que os testes TI e hml estão sendo executados com qualidade

  • Ser muito responsável e comprometido entregas.

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência minima de 7 anos comprovado atuando como Scrum Master, que tenha vivencia pratica em gestão de projetos de dados (BI, modelagens dados, migrações dados, integrações por API e inteligencia artificial).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Setor de varejo.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;

title: Gerente Regional de Operações Logísticas para Mercado Envios
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Ser responsável por liderar uma estrutura de operações de 05 Services Centers, garantindo o cumprimento e qualidade das entregas, focando a entrega “world-class delivery experience”.
  • Garantir que as operações funcionem de maneira eficiente e estejam alinhados aos procedimentos e princípios operacionais estabelecidos, sempre promovendo um ambiente seguro dentro das operações.
  • Construir, supervisionar, liderar e desenvolver uma equipe sólida, gerando um bom clima e comunicação entre os sites.
  • Aumentar o rendimento de segurança, qualidade, produtividade e capacidade das operações.
  • Alcançar as métricas operacionais da operação; assim como identificar desvios nas métricas, propor ações de melhoria e orientar com sua equipe.
  • Desenvolver e criar parcerias com áreas internas, tais como: Operations Excellence, Facilities, Manutenção, Safety, Fullfilment, com o objetivo de potencializar o ecossistema com foco no ótimo global.


Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa em Administração de Empresas, Economia e Engenharia ou outras áreas correlacionadas.
  • Ter atuado em organizações de compras estratégicas com experiência na gestão de equipes, com capacidade de planejamento e organização.
  • Possuir capacidade analítica e administração de dados e métricas para tomada de decisões.
  • Ter visão estratégica e orientação para resolução de problemas, com capacidade de diagnosticar, identificar oportunidades e construir soluções de alto impacto.
  • Atuar presencialmente no estado do Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou região metropolitana com disponibilidade para viagens na região.


Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)


O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com deficiência

Banco de Talentos destinado exclusivamente a pessoas com deficiência.


O Senac é a maior instituição de educação profissional do Brasil voltada para o comércio de bens, serviços e turismo. Role Overview:


As a Programming Scheduler at Nosso Futebol, you will be responsible for organizing and updating the daily programming schedule in the playout system, ensuring accuracy and alignment with the company’s editorial and operational strategies. This role requires attention to detail, the ability to adapt quickly to live changes, and close coordination with technical and content teams.

  • Monitor the schedule in real time, identifying inconsistencies or technical conflicts and proposing solutions in collaboration with the coordination team;


  • Collect and organize audience data from both linear and digital platforms to support content performance analysis;


  • Assist in verifying and validating the schedule with MCR and technical teams to ensure operational alignment;


  • Manage the content inventory, ensuring proper organization and availability of materials for airing.


Requirements:


  • Previous experience in TV programming, channel scheduling, or media operations;


  • Familiarity with playout systems such as Media+, Imagine, or similar;


  • Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and agility in handling real-time adjustments;


  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational teams;


  • Basic understanding of audience metrics and content performance indicators;


  • Proficiency in Excel and tools for content organization and control;

title: QA Performance Engineer
description:
Job Description

About you

We are looking for an experienced QA Performance Engineer responsible for planning, implementing and monitoring quality assurance strategies and procedures to give our clients the best service to ensure the non-functional requirements for performance are met.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • 4 years (minimum) as a QA analyst.
  • Experience with Azure services and distributed systems
  • Knowledge of performance testing and proven experience developing automated test cases using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, etc.
  • Understanding of REST APIs and network performance concepts
  • Knowledge of Azure Monitor, App Insights, Grafana.
  • Scripting with Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript.
  • Version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience with SQL Server profiling
  • Knowledge of automation and agile methodologies (SCRUM).

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Plan, analyze, design, develop, execute, and present results and automated test scenarios and maintain test data; this includes determining priority for test scenarios and creating execution plans to implement these scenarios.
  • Identify opportunities for automation within software processes, considering non-functional requirements.
  • Create, and implement performance testing strategy according to the performance needs of the different organizations.
  • Coordinate the test plans with project managers, development managers and others.
  • Initiate the planning, analysis, design, implementation, and execution of tests, monitor test progress and results, and check the status of exit criteria (or definition of done) for the Performance requirements.
  • Automate collection and delivery of test progress and test summary reports.
  • Support the selection and implementation of automation tools (JMeter, NeoLoad, LoadRunner).
  • Introduce suitable metrics for measuring test progress and evaluating the quality of the testing.


Qualifications

Knowledge of automation and agile methodologies (SCRUM), ISTQB certification (CFTL is a plus).

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Habilidades interpessoais como liderança, comunicação, organização e tomada de decisão.


Qual a Localização?

Rio de Janeiro/ RJ- Presencial



O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: IT Service Level Manager
description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.

To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!

British American Tobacco Brazil has an exciting opportunity for an IT Service Level Manager in Rio de Janeiro


The Service Level Manager (SLM) is responsible for ensuring that all IT services meet the agreed-upon service levels and performance standards. This role involves managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), monitoring service performance, and working closely with both internal teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality service delivery. The SLM will play a crucial role in aligning IT services with business objectives and customer expectations.

The position requires strong alignment with ITIL best practices, COBIT governance principles, and industry performance benchmarks. The SLM is also a key agent in driving continuous improvement, digital transformation, and the innovation of user-centric services.


Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop, negotiate, and manage SLAs with internal and external stakeholders and monitor and report on service performance against SLAs.
  • Conduct regular reviews of SLAs to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with business needs.
  • Maintain a centralized and accessible Service Catalogue and being responsible for ITSM governance, for example, incident, change, problem and transition management.
  • Use data-driven insights to predict and prevent potential service disruptions and analyze service performance and structured root cause analysis data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  • Manage capacity and delivery plan (internal and external teams)
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all service-related issues and escalations and communicate service performance and improvement plans to stakeholders.
  • Lead initiatives to improve service delivery processes and enhance customer satisfaction and promote user-centric innovation and stay updated with industry best practices and emerging trends in IT service management.
  • This position needs to manage all the running cost of IT, always looking for saving opportunities, cost avoidance and other ways to bring efficiency. Also responsible for IT Services project budget.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT service management or a related role.
  • Proven track record of managing SLAs and improving service delivery in a large organization and demonstrated success in managing SLAs, dashboards, vendor relationships, and governance reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.
  • Advanced English verbal and written; Spanish it´s a nice to have.
  • Experience Level Management (XLA) skills to enhance user experience levels and ensure smooth operations and strategic mindset with focus on innovation, agility, and experience management.


What we offer you?

• We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)

• Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives

• Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.

• You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills

• We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes

WHY JOIN BAT?

We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.


Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.


We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).


Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

Sales Manager


Our client, a global leader in asset integrity management software for the energy sector, is expanding in Brazil. We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial and ambitious Sales Manager to lead our commercial efforts locally — not just to drive sales, but to build and grow your own team and establish the company as a dominant player in the Brazilian oil & gas, petrochemical, and refinery markets.


This is not a traditional sales role. You will be the face of the company on the ground, owning the market development process end-to-end, forging strategic relationships, and executing innovative growth strategies to build a sustainable and high-performing sales operation from the ground up.


Your Role:

  • Develop and implement strategic plans to enter and grow in the Brazilian market.
  • Identify and approach high potential customers and build deep, trusted partnerships around the company’s cutting-edge software solutions.
  • Represent the company locally as a leader and industry expert, strengthening our brand and influence.
  • Continuously analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activity to stay ahead of the curve.
  • Deliver compelling solution-based presentations and demos to prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from lead generation through contract negotiation and closing.
  • Provide regular sales reports, forecasts, and updates to global leadership.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and outstanding customer success.
  • Build, mentor, and grow your own sales and service team to scale the company’s footprint long-term.


What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (MBA or advanced degree a plus);
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales management in the oil & gas industry (asset integrity, NDT, or related areas);
  • Proven success track record of opening new markets and exceeding ambitious sales targets;
  • Deep understanding of asset integrity concepts like NDT, RBI, and inspection methodologies;
  • A bold entrepreneurial spirit with a hands-on, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset;
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working autonomously while aligning with global HQ strategies;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English;
  • Legally authorized to work and currently residing in Brazil.


Preferred:

  • Experience selling industrial or SaaS solutions, certifications in NDT/RBI, and knowledge of Brazilian oil & gas regulations;
  • Certifications in NDT or RBI.


Why Join This Opportunity?


This is your opportunity to shape the future of asset integrity software in Brazil with the backing of a trusted, global brand. If you are motivated to create something meaningful, thrive on challenges, and have the vision to lead and grow a successful sales organization, apply now or contact us for more information.


Drive Local Growth. Lead Sales Strategy. Build the Future.

  • Manage relationships with payroll providers and ensure system accuracy.

Invoicing & Billing:

title: Gerente Divisional
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma das maiores indústrias farmacêutica da América Latina?

A Blau é uma indústria farmacêutica líder no segmento hospitalar e pioneira em biotecnologia, com portfólio proprietário de medicamentos de alta complexidade com foco em segmentos relevantes na indústria, como imunologia, hematologia, oncologia, especialidades, antibióticos em diversas classes, entre outros.

A Blau possui footprint continental, presente em seis países da América Latina e nos Estados Unidos e possui um moderno complexo industrial farmacêutico, composto por cinco plantas industriais, com tecnologia de ponta, dedicadas à produção de medicamentos biológicos, biotecnológicos, oncológicos, antibióticos, anestésicos injetáveis e insumos biotecnológicos.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Analisar o desempenho de vendas e promoção, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das gerências regionais, assegurando a manutenção da política comercial, performance da linha de produtos, incremento de preço médio e rentabilidade da linha, além do controle da inadimplência, de acordo com as metas estabelecidas pela companhia utilizando as ferramentas de auditoria.
  • Alinhamento das informações de mercado junto à Diretoria, com indicação de preços de mercado, visando contribuir com aumento de Market Share e Margem;
  • Manter atualização sobre as tendências de mercado, identificando possíveis concorrentes, avaliar os preços e reajustes previstos, visando apresentar relatórios para contribuir com a tomada de decisão pela Diretoria Comercial;
  • Reportar eventuais participações em Eventos e Congressos, voltados ao negócio hospitalar e oncológico;
  • Demonstrar liderança através de ferramentas disponibilizadas pela empresa, visando a uniformidade de procedimentos e aumento de produtividade.
  • Interagir com as Sociedades Médicas de cada região, com objetivo de estreitar relacionamento e ampliar o reconhecimento de nossa marca junto as classes médicas;
  • Avaliar os custos/despesas e alocação de recursos;
  • Avaliar as metas e setorização juntamente com a estrutura hierárquica;
  • Atuar em sintonia com o Marketing estabelecendo ações que contribuam para incremento do portfólio de produtos;
  • Participar da formulação do orçamento anual da empresa;
  • Cumprir os objetivos mensais e anuais de venda, visitação e orçamentários;
  • Elaborar a previsão de vendas, bem como o cumprimento da política comercial e de descontos;
  • Analisar relatórios de vendas a fim de manter controle sobre as vendas previstas versus realizadas;
  • Garantir o alinhamento das competências da Força de Vendas conforme o modelo empregado pela Blau Farmacêutica para cada função/cargo, bem como a execução do Plano de desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) para todos os integrantes do time;
  • Garantir que a mensagem institucional seja replicada para todos os níveis de seu time de forma ágil e sem alterações;
  • Realizar os treinamentos para capacitação técnica e comportamental da Blau Farmacêutica;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de todas as políticas e as normas do Código de Ética e Conflitos de Interesses da organização, bem como as requeridas pela legislação local;
  • Reunião de alinhamento e Coaching com Gerentes Regionais;


Necessário

  • Formação superior completa
  • Pós-graduado e/ou MBA em áreas compatíveis a função
  • Experiência como Gerente de Vendas e/ou Promoção (GR ou GD (sênior)); ou posição estratégica equivalente com expertise em gestão de pessoas.
  • Disponibilidade para atender toda região norte, nordeste, RJ e MG.
  • Necessário residir no RJ ou Nordeste



Gostou? Inscreva-se e venha ser um Blauer!


A Blau respeita e apoia a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo.

Sobre a Tidewise

A Tidewise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.

title: Strategic Operations Analyst
description:
Job Post: Strategic Operations Analyst

Full-Time | Associate / Analyst Level

Department: Strategic Solutions

About the Role:

We are looking for a Strategic Operations Analyst to join our Strategic Solutions Department. This role is key to driving internal efficiency, strengthening data integrity, and enhancing cross-departmental collaboration. You’ll act as a strategic enabler and systems observer, ensuring that our CRM/PRM tools are used effectively to generate insights and support long-term planning.

If you are analytical, process-minded, and proactive in maintaining high-quality internal data, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Intelligence & PRM/CRM Oversight

  • Monitor CRM/PRM data to detect gaps in client engagement history.
  • Follow up with Sales Directors and team members to ensure accurate data logging.
  • Analyze CRM/PRM data to identify trends, support reporting, and generate strategic insights.

Cross-Functional Process Understanding

  • Map and document workflows across departments.
  • Observe meetings and shadow teams to identify silos and inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to drive clarity, redundancy, or cross-training.

Strategic Support & Insights

  • Support leadership with initiatives like client segmentation, performance reviews, and market analysis.
  • Extract and present data for strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain a log of observations, bottlenecks, and actionable suggestions.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Keep SOPs and internal process documents up-to-date.
  • Deliver recurring summaries with data quality status, key insights, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to quarterly presentations and strategic overviews.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, or internal consulting.
  • Fluent in English
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent communication and follow-up skills—especially with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; BI tools a plus.

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
Descrição:

Gerenciar equipe e supervisionar a realização das atividades da área, elaborando relatórios de controle e monitoramento, prestando assistência aos parceiros comerciais, acompanhando auditorias externas, conduzindo a equipe nos processos de entrega e devolução de quiosques, realizando análise de viabilidade de captação de novos produtos e parceiros, bem como fortalecendo o relacionamento com os operadores, visando garantir a prestação de serviços de qualidade aos clientes.


Atribuições:

  • Promover avaliação periódica da equipe, através da análise dos relatórios de produtividade, prestando feedbacks semanais, a fim de acompanhar o desempenho, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e auxiliar no desenvolvimento dos colaboradores.
  • Prestar assistência aos parceiros Comerciais, coordenando o acompanhamento das faltas e/ou intercorrências de produtos, para monitoramento do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Acompanhar mensalmente a auditoria externa (Contrato Ambev), presencialmente, prestando informações e auxílio aos auditores, para cumprimento de cláusulas contratuais e conferência do mix obrigatório de produtos nos quiosques.
  • Efetuar fechamento de Auditoria (Contrato Ambev), após a auditoria realizar conferência dos arquivos referentes, a fim de enviar à Ambev e ao setor Financeiro para encerramento do processo e emissão das notas fiscais para pagamento.
  • Acompanhar auditoria diária dos quiosques, através da agenda de visitas dos consultores e reporte do Supervisor, para conferência do cumprimento dos contratos.
  • Elaborar relatórios de controle operacional mensal ou mediante demanda elencando todas as atividades e resultados do departamento, incluindo evidências fotográficas de status dos quiosques se necessário, enviando os dados para acompanhamento pela diretoria.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com outros departamentos (Atendimento ao Cliente, Manutenção, Auditoria, Postos e Bases, Comercial, Merchandising) conforme agendamento mensal, semanal ou de urgência específica, para alinhamento de andamento de processos, troca de ideias, resolução de problemas e definição de planos de ação.
  • Realizar estudo de viabilidade de novos produtos e/ou parceiros, analisando juntamente com o departamento de atendimento ao cliente, visando trazer maiores resultados aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar relatórios sanitários, conforme reporte da equipe de sanitaristas, para monitoramento das atividades realizadas e do desempenho de cada quiosque.
  • Promover/participar de reuniões com novos operadores, através de agendamento prévio, visando alinhamento de execução do plano de ação inicial operacional onde são dispostas as principais demandas e obrigatoriedades do operador.
  • Garantir cadastro de novos clientes efetuando o processo junto aos operadores via sistema Check List, para obter os dados necessários para firmar novos parceiros e ações.
  • Acompanhar equipe nas inaugurações e entrega de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com operadores e departamentos responsáveis, garantindo o preenchimento de relatórios e termos pertinentes, a fim de criar comunicação efetiva com o cliente e garantir a qualidade das entregas.
  • Atuar junto à equipe nas devoluções de quiosques, por meio de visitas agendadas com o operador e departamento de Manutenção, assegurando o preenchimento de checklist de vistoria e o termo de devolução de posse assinado, para documentar o estado do quiosque na data, bem como obter evidências para realizar cobrança de itens que não estiverem em conformidade.
  • Fechar penalidades de todos os contratos que geram receita para a empresa, via sistema Totvs, para que o financeiro faça o fechamento contábil das receitas da empresa.
  • Cadastrar amarração de contratos Ambev via sistema Totvs, para identificação dos clientes correspondentes para posterior fechamento de penalidades (auxiliando o departamento Jurídico), para garantir que o setor Financeiro efetue o fechamento contábil da referida empresa.
  • Promover reuniões/treinamentos mensais a equipe, abordando temas como: comunicação, relacionamento com cliente e ética profissional, visando orientar e desenvolver para obter melhor performance dos colaboradores e uma gestão mais eficiente.
  • Promover a integração entre os operadores e a empresa, realizando reuniões semanais, visando manter um relacionamento de feedback essencial para proporcionar melhoria na prestação de serviços.
  • Coordenar implantação dos projetos, montagem e execução de operações externas, realizando estudo da viabilidade através da análise do objetivo do cliente, visando garantir entregas de qualidade para os operadores.
  • Acompanhar auditoria e controle financeiro do Contrato Souza Cruz, realizando acompanhamento das vendas, levantamento e cobrança aos operadores das dívidas e envio de fechamento mensal do contrato, para cumprimento das cláusulas contratuais da parceria comercial.
  • Elaborar relatórios semanais de acompanhamento de obras, através das fotos enviadas pela equipe e contato com os operadores e demais setores, para monitorar a execução de obras nos quiosques.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharias, Publicidade e Propagando ou áreas correlatas.

  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em campo;
  • Ter CNH B;
  • Ter experiência com o sistema Totvs.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Job Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy.
